name: BIS Data Portal SDMX API
summary: Keyless SDMX 2.1/3.0 REST API for Bank for International Settlements statistics: policy rates, effective exchange rates, credit, debt securities, banking and derivatives data.
description: The BIS Statistics API serves the data published on data.bis.org. At check the dataflow list for agency BIS held 29 dataflows, including central bank policy rates (WS_CBPOL), effective exchange rates (WS_EER), central bank total assets, consolidated banking statistics and CPMI payment statistics. It follows SDMX REST v2: structure queries return dataflows, data structures and codelists, data queries return series keyed by dimension codes. Data can be returned as SDMX-JSON, SDMX-ML or CSV.

Series for a dimension key such as M.N.B.US; use . and + as wildcard and OR

license.name: BIS terms of permitted use of BIS statistics: unrestricted use provided the BIS is cited as source

coverage.geographic: Global, reported by central banks and national authorities

agent_notes: Dataflow ids look like WS_EER, WS_CBPOL. Read /structure/dataflow/BIS first, then the dataflow's datastructure for dimension order; a data key lists one value per dimension separated by dots (empty = all, + = OR). The response format follows the Accept header (application/vnd.sdmx.data+csv;version=2.0.0, application/vnd.sdmx.data+json;version=1.0.0) or the format query parameter (csv confirmed); with only Accept: application/json the data endpoint returned SDMX-ML XML. Use lastNObservations or startPeriod to keep responses small.
caveats: The API documentation at stats.bis.org/api-doc/v2 is a script-rendered page; no machine-readable OpenAPI file was found.
Default data format is SDMX-ML XML unless you ask for csv or json.
The statistics are compiled by central banks; the BIS asks that translations are not presented as official BIS translations.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key; 200 with text/csv.
